# Pinned FP8 kernel

`finegrained_fp8/` contains the unmodified Python kernel source used by the
original Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8 backbone extraction. Origin:
https://huggingface.co/kernels-community/finegrained-fp8,
version 4, snapshot `8c178950e8710e26a2210e4e909cd02dc16c8715`.

The upstream Apache-2.0 notices in the source files are retained. File digests
and signed upstream metadata are recorded in `kernel_manifest.json`. The loader
verifies every digest before importing the kernel. Model weights are not bundled.
